reviews_h2: What people are saying about the tree service

reviews.author: Dana Martinez
reviews.text: I saw Arbor Ave in my neighborhood two days in a row, so I decided to ask if I could schedule a quote. To my surprise, they were able to provide one on the spot and schedule the work for just two days later. Their quick response and availability exceeded my expectations.I had several trees that needed trimming to allow more sunlight to reach my solar panels. The crew arrived promptly and safely removed the large limbs that were blocking the sunlight. They worked efficiently, cleaned up as they went, and were extremely professional throughout the entire process.Thank you again for the excellent service and all that you did for us. I highly recommend Arbor Ave to anyone looking for reliable and professional tree services.

reviews.author: contra c
reviews.text: We recently hired Arbor Aves to remove a very large, hazardous tree that was dangerously close to our house, and we couldn’t be happier with the results. From the very first call, they demonstrated professionalism and expertise. They came out and took the time to look at the tree we wanted removed, explained the risks in detail, and answered every question we had with clear, knowledgeable answers. What really stood out was their flexibility. With my wife’s and I demanding work schedule, they worked around our availability and even adjusted the date when an unexpected conflict came up. They truly made the process easy and stress-free. The day of the job, the weather turned nasty with rain, but the crew showed up ready and completed the entire removal safely and efficiently. There was a moment of nervousness on our part, because the tree was so close to our house and surrounded by utilities and other structures nearby. The team used their crane with incredible precision, sectioning and lowering every piece without a single scratch to our house, gutters, nearby structures, or power lines. It was truly impressive to watch. Arbor Aves delivered exceptional customer service from start to finish. They eased all of our concerns and kept us informed. I highly recommend them to anyone needing tree work. Professional, skilled, and reliable.

reviews.author: John Waldrop
reviews.text: Arbor aves tree serviced did a great job cutting 10 trees for me. 6 big tall long leaf pines and 4 good size oaks. They did a great clean up job. Grinding the stumps, and cleaning up all the debris. Very good price, a job well done in a timely manner. The did the work in less than one day.

reviews.author: ann H
reviews.text: Can't say enough good things about Jacob and his crew! They knocked it out of the park on the job they did for me. This is the second time they have helped me and today they reclaimed a good part of the yard for me that had storm damage debris and was overgrown. Very happy from start to finish with communication all the way to clean-up afterwards. Will definitely call them for any future needs.

reviews.author: Matthew Argo
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier with the experience I had with Arbor Ave’s Tree and Crane. From the initial quote to the final cleanup, everything was handled with a high level of professionalism. Their pricing was fair and transparent, no surprises, just honest value for the quality of work delivered. What really stood out was their planning and communication. Everything was done efficiently and safely. The crew operated like a well-oiled machine, each team member knew their role, and their coordination made the job look seamless. Safety was obviously a top priority throughout the entire project. They took great care to protect my property and themselves, using proper equipment and following best practices at every step. It gave me real peace of mind knowing the job was being done the right way. Overall, I highly recommend Arbor Ave’s Tree and Crane to anyone looking for reliable, skilled, and professional tree cutting services.

reviews.author: Kaylee Shalongo
reviews.text: Avery and his team were absolutely fantastic! They removed four large pines from my property quickly, safely, and with impressive efficiency. The whole crew was professional, friendly, and clearly knew exactly what they were doing. On top of that, their pricing was very reasonable compared to other quotes I received, which made the experience even better. I would absolutely recommend Avery to anyone looking to get trees removed ASAP!

reviews.author: Mark Philemon
reviews.text: Had Aves tree experts come help remove 9 big Bradford pear trees and chip the trees. Was very pleasant to deal with showed up when he said he would, was very respectful of the property. worked hard! Also the best price around! I well be useing them again.

reviews.author: Pat Brewster
reviews.text: 5 stars is not enough! They are incredibly efficient, hardworking, knowledgeable and polite. I can’t say enough good things about this company. If you need a tree removed, don’t hesitate to contact Avery. All this comes at a very reasonable price.

reviews.author: Logan
reviews.text: Avery and his team were great! Got a quote from him, and the team was there and took out 10 trees in less than a day. Will likely use them again, and would recommend. Great Service!

reviews.author: M Massey
reviews.text: Arbor Aves Tree Experts are truly EXPERTS. Avery, Jacob, and Crew were professional, friendly, courteous, HARD WORKING with an impeccable work ethic! They removed a very large Maple and Oak tree from my yard. The limb and trunk removal was precise. They did not damage any of my azaleas which was amazing in itself. The cleanup was spotless. I HIGHLY RECOMMEND this tree service. A ++ Service provided!

reviews.author: Lindley Johnson
reviews.text: Avery & his crew did amazing! They took care of a big tree we were concerned with and dropped it with ease! Very professional and cleaned up all the debris! Highly recommend

reviews.author: Jeff Patton
reviews.text: They did a fantastic job removing a few trees and grinding some stumps at my house in Matthews, NC. Highly recommend using them. They were prompt and responsive and were the most competitive based on price.

reviews.author: Paul Johnson
reviews.text: We used Arbor Aves to remove three large trees. One right next to our house. Avery and his crew did an amazing job. These guys know what they are doing. They were the most professional, courteous, and safety conscious tree company I’ve ever hired. (I have hired a few over the years). I highly recommend this company.

reviews.author: Rick Ulrich
reviews.text: These guys don't mess around--they have a good group of workers and climbers and they get the job done quickly and efficiently...all at a very reasonable price!

reviews.author: Ian Murphy
reviews.text: We had a fantastic experience working with Arbor Aves. From start to finish, they were friendly, professional, and incredibly helpful. We contacted them to remove a total of nine trees from our yard, and they took the time to walk us through all of our options, including stump removal and the best strategies for managing the space moving forward. Their pricing was very competitive, and we were especially impressed by how quickly and efficiently they completed the job. Not only did they handle the tree removal with care, but they also cleaned up all the debris and even helped remove some weeds, above and beyond what we expected. We would highly recommend Arbor Aves to anyone looking for efficient, reliable, and high-quality tree service. They truly made the whole process easy and stress-free.

reviews.author: sandra applequist
reviews.text: Avery and his crew spent the whole day removing Leyland Cypress trees 6 on our property and 3 on neighbors. 1 was 70 feet. All went well and these guys worked thru the sleet and snow as it fell for the last several hours of the day. Very efficient crew at work and clean-up. Highly recommend.

reviews.author: Diego Sanchez
reviews.text: These guys were great. They came out to our property to look at the tree we needed removed, gave us a quote, and came back the same day and had the job done. Extremely professional and efficient, all of the crew knew what they were doing and what had to be done. Cleaned up the yard very nicely after they were done chopping up the tree. Would definitely recommend.

reviews.author: Robert Decker
reviews.text: Avery and his team of highly trained tree experts performed amazing work over two rigorous days with incredible results. Every member of the team fully knew their job and executed to a phenomenal standard!! Each member was truly outstanding, but the individual efforts of Avery, Nicholas, Jacob and Austin were particularly exceptional. Of note, Avery Hunt's team uses state of the art equipment and techniques to ensure the job is done efficiently and safely. In short, I couldn't have been more satisfied with removal of trees, several which were 90 feet tall, tree trimming, stump grinding and clearing of unwanted debris. Bottom line: this team is unmatched in what they do!!! --BG (RET) Bob Decker, Pinehurst

reviews.author: CORNEL NAVORI
reviews.text: Avery and his team have helped me several times in clearing and trimming the trees around the property. Professional, dedicated and knowledgable with a great attitude and friendly. They have always delivered what they promised and more. Highly recommended.

reviews.author: David Boals
reviews.text: I called Arbor Aves to come by for a quote to take down a big tree next to my house. Avery came by, gave me a fair quote and had his guys working within the hour. Great crew and they did a great job. Recommend.

reviews.author: Tara Paley
reviews.text: Avery came in, evaluated needs, and got right to work. Great crew, super coordinated, safe and fast. Clean up was great. Trees look happy.

reviews.author: April Watson
reviews.text: They came out to cut down a huge, dead tree in our yard. They showed up the day we got in contact and had it taken care of within 30 minutes. They cleaned everything up and their price was amazing. I will definitely use them again for any tree removal and I highly recommend them if you need that service. Great company!

reviews.author: Scott Southern
reviews.text: They where on my road doing work for multiple Nabiours because everyone seen how good of a job and how reasonable there prices where. I only had them grind a stump for me seeing I don’t have many trees but I looked at the work they did for everyone else and did an awesome job.

reviews.author: Tammy Steger
reviews.text: Needed two large pine trees removed. They came by quickly with a fair quote and took care of the trees within a couple of hours. My father in law (who can be hard to impress) couldn't stop talking about what a great job they did. Would highly recommend!!

reviews.author: Nate Lambert
reviews.text: Man… these guys crushed it. I called Arbor Aves around 8 PM and by 0830 the next morning their crew was at my house. Austin and Jacob arrived and were extremely professional. Within 15-minutes they were up in the tree going to work. Our experience was nothing but professionalism and we will absolutely use them in the future. Thank you gentlemen!

reviews.author: Dan McCoy
reviews.text: Arbor Aves took down 4 large trees and trimmed two other trees for us recently in the Pinehurst area. They ground the stumps as well. Their pricing was competitive, their crew professional, and their work very good. We’d use them again if we ever have the need.

reviews.author: Leigha
reviews.text: Avery and his crew were quick to respond when I contacted them about tree issues on my property. Avery was prompt, knowledgeable, friendly, and competent in assessing my trees and determining the best course of action. He even pointed out some areas of concern I had not noticed. His team completed the work the same day of the estimate. I would recommend this service to anyone dealing with tree trimming or removal.

reviews.author: Cindy Maupin
reviews.text: I couldn’t be happier! The job was done by real professionals that went above and beyond what I expected. Friendly, hardworking and great price. I would highly recommend them and will definitely be using them again.

reviews.author: FarRightLark

Based on this positive experience, I intend to utilize their services again in the future.

And the price was very fair. I got home and could not even tell they had been there. Highly recommend these guys !!

reviews.author: Patti Huggins
reviews.text: Avery and one of his workers brought me a load of mulch. (I had signed up with ChipDrop.) I was very impressed with the work ethic of this fine group of young men; their energy, courtesy and efficiency. So glad that I now know they all live in and around Davidson County. Avery seems genuinely committed to quality and reasonable charges that is so helpful to senior citizens. I highly recommend Arbor Aves Tree Experts.

We have used him a second time and has also done tree removal for my sister in law. I highly recommend him!

They live in Davidson County, (THOMASVILLE & Lexington)- work regularly in Moore County and Pinehurst area. More than pleased, reasonable rate!

reviews.text: Avery and the team are amazing! I have used them twice on hard to remove trees close to fences and neighbor properties that other companies wouldn't touch. They are professional and do a great job. They have also cleaned up and trimmed other trees on my property.

reviews.text: They did a great job and were very nice. And even got the job done on the same day for me. I will definitely be calling them again.

reviews.author: Elizabeth Waugh
reviews.text: Very positive experience! We were introduced to this company after an ice storm when we had a large tree fall on our patio. Quick cleanup at an awesome price. We’ve hired them on several occasions since to remove around 12 trees on different occasions. Very reasonable pricing, quality service, and customer oriented. Will hire again!

reviews.author: Gayle Madden
reviews.text: Avery came by and assessed our trees for cutting. We fully plan to use him in the future because of how responsive he is. Everything about his service is friendly and professional. We also felt very in control of our service as he’s not pushy or aggressive about his job at all.

reviews.author: Troy Holloway
reviews.text: Professional is an understatement. This crew did everything perfectly, from tree removal to keeping my yard from being torn up! Needed trees pruined but was unsure the look I was going for and the experience of these guys definetly showed when it was all said and done! Great company, will use/recommend them for any job in the future!

reviews.author: Kathryn Westmoreland
reviews.text: Loved them! Had a whole team out here on time got the tree removed off of my house before I could even blink, even cleaned up my driveway for me!! The stump removal man was nice and quick to remove the rest of the tree as well for us.

reviews.author: Cathy Gold
reviews.text: We had a tall pine that split at the base in the last storm and was leaning toward the neighbor's fence. While no one else was even calling us back, Avery and his team came out, explained the options, and took care of it for us for a fair price. They're friendly and honest, cleaned up really well, and we will definitely be calling again.

reviews.author: Deana K
reviews.text: I was just hit by a wind/snow storm and lost 6 trees. Mr. Avery and his team removed all trees, restored the area by removing all debris, even raking. They were professional, timely and responsive. The price was fair and showed up when I needed them.

reviews.author: Scott Nix
reviews.text: Great service this morning from the crew. They removed a tree that was close to our house and took every precautious to keep our property safe. The guys showed up on time and confirmed the job details prior to starting. We will definitely use Arbor Aves in the future.

reviews.author: Dani Andino

reviews.author: Betsy Moore
reviews.text: Absolutely top notch team, Excellent customer service, quick, professional and so tidy, highly recommend for your tree removal.

reviews.text: I call these guys at 8 am for a quote. They showed up 30 min later with a reasonable price so I hired the. They finished removing a 65 ft pine and had everything cleaned up in 30 min. The owner is a gentleman who stands by his work and more importantly his word.

reviews.author: Jakub Blank
reviews.text: The team came in did their work quickly and efficiently and for a good price. thank you Arobor Aves! will for sure recommend

reviews.author: Steve Beck
reviews.text: The whole team was on point. Professional, and polite. They trimmed 10-15 tree branches and took out 3 dead trees. Cleaned up after, and was very reasonable on the price. I would highly recommend them!

reviews.author: Lora Clinton
reviews.text: These guys were great. They were very professional and were very respectful of my property and the property of my neighbors. Avery and his team young but very experienced.

reviews.author: Christopher Cole
reviews.text: The Arbor Aves team did some much needed tree trimming to trim down and lift 2 overgrown pin oak trees that were growing over top of my house that were causing some cosmetic damage to spouting and shingles. They also cut down a dead pine on the property. The pin oak trim helped solve an ongoing problem by cutting off an easy path for Squirrels to travel from the tree onto the top of my roof which eliminated easy access to enter my attic. The team was very professional and removed all the debris that was trimmed. Scheduling to do the work was easy - scheduled and completed the job within a weeks time. Will call them again when the need arises.

reviews.author: Kelly Kitchen
reviews.text: Avery and his crew were very responsive and collaborative from first call through job completion. They asked great questions to clarify what I wanted and also provided solid guidance to my questions. Thank you for great service!

reviews.author: Phillip Locklear
reviews.text: They do a great job for a fair price. I highly recommend, the only reason I gave a four is because they need to improve their cleanup and they parked a piece of equipment on my property overnight without asking.

reviews.author: Ned Perkins
reviews.text: On time and very professional. Went beyond expectations and very friendly and positive. I definitely reccomend Avery and his crew and will use his service again.

reviews.author: Tesa Jones

reviews.author: Rodney Moore

reviews.author: Michael Hodges

I recommend them to all and would use their service again without a doubt.

reviews.author: JP J

reviews.text: I so impressed with this company! They even refreshed our land with new pine straw and I had no idea he was gonna do that! Next he’s gonna bring his Air Bucket and trim up the larger pines. Don’t call anyone else.
